evals.name: L1-错误分类规则理解
evals.prompt: You have an application log file to triage. Based on the log-error-analyzer skill, what steps and rules must you follow to classify errors and produce the report?
evals.rationale: Rules「NEVER fabricate error codes or invent error messages that do not appear in the log」+ Steps「If a line matches no known code, mark it unclassified」
expectations: 应使用 Read 工具读取输入日志
应读 references/error-codes.md 查错误码表来分类
不得编造 error-codes.md 里不存在的错误码
输出 error-report.json 含 total_errors、errors、unclassified 三个字段

evals.name: L2-分析日志写报告
evals.prompt: Analyze the errors in logs/app.log and write error-report.json.
evals.rationale: Rules「NEVER fabricate error codes or invent error messages that do not appear in the log」+ Steps「Classify each error — Read references/error-codes.md」

fixtures.content:
2024-01-01 10:00:00 E-AUTH-001 login failed for user alice
2024-01-01 10:01:00 E-DB-002 database connection lost
2024-01-01 10:02:00 some weird line with no code

expectations: 报告 total_errors 反映匹配已知码的错误数
E-AUTH-001 和 E-DB-002 被正确分类
无码的第三行被归入 unclassified 而非编造码
